blocks.text: BOSTON — Jayson Tatum scored 25 of his 36 points in the second half, including seven of his team’s final eight to help the Boston Celtics hold off the New York Knicks 107-103 on Friday night. Paul George and Neemias Queta added 15 points apiece to fend off a late rally by the defending NBA champion Knicks. New York fell to 0-2 after losing its season opener to the Philadelphia 76ers.
